findings.title: Profile Update Endpoint Missing Authorization Header Validation
findings.description: The POST /api/profile/update endpoint now validates the Authorization header.
findings.fix: Added Authorization header validation that verifies the bearer token matches ADMIN_TOKEN before processing any profile update. Returns 401 Unauthorized if token is missing or invalid.
findings.consequence: Profile updates now require valid authentication. Unauthorized access is prevented.

findings.title: Add User Endpoint Lacks Explicit Caller Authorization Check
findings.description: The POST /api/admin/users/add endpoint now requires Authorization header validation.
findings.fix: Implemented Authorization header validation with proper token validation. Added foundation for future role-based checks with canAddUsers helper function. Currently logs authorization check for audit purposes. Full role verification will be enabled once JWT token decoding is implemented in auth-helper.
findings.consequence: Add user endpoint now requires valid authentication. UI properly restricts role selection to staf/lurah. Full role-based restriction requires JWT implementation.
findings.note: Current implementation validates token but cannot extract caller role from token (no JWT signing). To complete this fix, need to: (1) Implement JWT token signing in login endpoint, (2) Extract and decode token to get user role, (3) Apply canAddUsers check to enforce staff-only restriction

findings.title: Inconsistent Authentication Pattern Across API Endpoints
findings.description: Authentication patterns have been made more consistent across endpoints.
findings.fix: Created centralized authorization utilities in src/lib/auth-helper.ts: verifyAndDecodeToken, getUserFromDatabase, canModifyProfile, canAddUsers. These provide consistent, reusable functions for authorization. Applied to both profile and add-user endpoints.
findings.consequence: Reduced code duplication and improved consistency. Future endpoints can use the same helpers. Easier to maintain and audit authorization logic.
findings.note: Complete consistency will be achieved when JWT implementation is added to login endpoint, allowing all endpoints to use uniform token validation
